verdict.rationale: The Hoppscotch CLI runs API tests from a terminal or automated system, and `hopp test` can generate a JUnit report for collection runs. Together these deliver collection-level automated test execution with a machine-readable pass/fail report. Test cases are scriptable per request. Missing for 10: a detailed description of the pass/fail report contents and exit-code behaviour, documentation of the in-app collection runner, and independent or hands-on corroboration of collection runs.
